overviewHtml:
AI assistants often invent action names and template syntax when asked for Dynatrace workflows. This AGENTS.md instruction file gives them the correct rules.

What you get

  • Coverage of YAML templates, API JSON and Terraform formats
  • Workflow structure: tasks, conditions, triggers and loops
  • Examples for DQL, JavaScript, HTTP, email, Jira, Slack and Teams actions
  • Jinja2 expressions, best practices and troubleshooting
  • A pull request review checklist for syntax, security and DQL
prereqsHtml:
• An AI coding assistant that reads AGENTS.md, or that lets you add custom instructions
  • Dynatrace SaaS with Workflows, to import and test the generated workflows
setupHtml:
1. Download AGENTS.md.
  2. Put it in the root of the repository where you keep your workflows. Assistants that support the AGENTS.md convention pick it up automatically. For others, add its content as custom instructions, for example .github/copilot-instructions.md or a Cursor rule.
  3. Ask the assistant to create or review a workflow, then import the result in Workflows and test it.
getStartedHtml:
You need an AI assistant that reads AGENTS.md or custom instructions, and Dynatrace Workflows.

  1. Download the instruction file
  2. Place it in your workflow repository or add it as custom instructions
  3. Ask the assistant to create or review a workflow, then test it
